name: Amirmohammad Shams
summary: Full-stack developer with 10 years of software engineering experience across modern web, backend, and mobile systems. I build scalable React and Next.js applications, Node.js and NestJS APIs, and Firebase-backed platforms, with strong experience in system design, databases, testing, CI/CD, and cloud deployment. I bring additional expertise in Flutter and Android development, with end-to-end ownership from architecture and implementation through testing and production deployment. I am experienced in distributed teams, concurrent freelance projects, and technical mentorship.
